provenance.producer: Independent python-docx and Pillow source created for the FountainJS conversion audit; never produced by Fountain's DOCX exporter.
provenance.generator: scripts/create-conversion-stress-fixture.py plus the original audit's OOXML additions
provenance.data: Synthetic Newton cooling model, not measured experimental data. Original file bytes are unchanged.
provenance.nativeComparison: Render source and actual browser-downloaded export using the same isolated LibreOffice environment. Completion of the audit is not a pixel-fidelity pass or Microsoft Word certification.
